_comment: Shaped like SAP Cloud Transport Management's own node/route definition (the same JSON the Landscape Wizard produces and the TMS REST API accepts) - see this folder's README for why the topology is CF-space-scoped rather than cross-subaccount, and for which values below are real vs. placeholder.

nodes.name: DEV
nodes.description: Development - real, matches infra/terraform's provisioned CF org/space

nodes.name: QA
nodes.description: Quality Assurance - placeholder, same status as infra/terraform/environments/qa/terraform.tfvars

routes.description: Automated - triggered by tmsUpload once wired into Jenkinsfile.cf/kyma-deploy's Kyma-side equivalent

Manual approval - a real production promotion should never be fully automatic; CTMS's own approval workflow on this route is the mechanism, the same intent this project's GitHub Actions workflows express via required-reviewer GitHub Environments
